environment: Production static export, Codex in-app browser, localhost:3002/performance-check.html
fault: The initial worker URL was based on file:///ROOT/lib/useBattleExecutor.ts. Worker creation failed and the hook ran its synchronous fallback.
fix: Use the bundler worker&url asset import. The export verifier rejects local-file worker URL bases and checks emitted worker references.
orderMetric: Asynchronous request-to-result elapsed time, not main-thread CPU time
remaining: Reaction frames still exceed the 16.8 ms measurement threshold. The warm repeat rules out a purely first-use asset delay. Night, simultaneous group movement and full campaign combat are not covered by these samples.
